verdict.rationale: A taxpayer portal could plausibly let users download their filings and account data, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no export capability. The XML format applies only to inbound 1099 submissions to the portal. The Open Data Portal is a public historic business-license search, not an export of the user's own account data. The authenticated portal was never examined for download features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
